mentions.name: CAOS
mentions.description: Self-hosted workspace for managing security questionnaires, privacy assessments, vendor risk reviews, procurement due diligence, and evidence requests as structured, answerable projects. Questionnaires become a system of record: finished answers and compliance documents form a searchable, citable corpus, so each new questionnaire starts from prior answers with every claim traceable to its source document. Recently open-sourced.
mentions.problem: SaaS vendors managing PII data must handle security questionnaires, privacy assessments, vendor risk reviews, procurement due diligence, and evidence requests from customer security teams; with 500+ enterprise customers and annual vendor reviews, tracking these in Google Drive and Jira became unmanageable.
mentions.audience: SaaS vendors that manage PII data and must respond to customer security teams' assessments, vendor risk reviews, and evidence requests.
mentions.source_excerpt:
CAOS is a dedicated workspace that helps us manage these assessments like projects, additionally, CAOS turns the questionnaires into a system of record. Questionnaires become structured, answerable work. Finished answers and your compliance documents become a searchable, citable corpus. The next questionnaire starts from what you already said, with every claim traceable to the document or prior answer it came from.

It is self-hosted. Your policies, your answers, and your customers' questionnaires stay on your infrastructure.

Recently open-sourced - https://github.com/DigiCred-OSS/caos-os
mentions.author: joddystreet
